nonvacuity: Compiled scratch/Nonvacuity.lean with sap-lean: T16Review.nonvacuity constructs a family, p, j, designs and coefficient sequence satisfying every hypothesis of ResidualOLSConclusionsW2, together with Valid. The instance has n_k=k+1, independent fair-sign coordinates, empty true and recruitment graphs, zero caps, theta_i=1, p=1, an intercept-only design and b_k=0. Scaling holds with constants (1,1,1,2), n_k Var(betaHat)=1 at every size, and DesignRegularW2 holds with Bx=By=lambda=1. This also supplies instances of the finite OLS and raw-oracle premises. Separately, scratch/Witness.lean independently proves the entire concrete RawSlopeShiftWitnessW2, including its mean model, inverse domain, OLS weights, unchanged slope/residuals and raw values 0 and 1/2. Both scratch proofs depend only on propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound, with no use of T16. Exact rational enumeration in scratch/check_star.py checks all 3072 elementary draws of the lower-star block, joint independence of the leaves, the conditional center law, mean vector (3/4,1/4,1/4,1/4), covariance matrix, and the constants 27/128, -3/128 and 15/64. Across blocks the source law is a uniform product, giving independent draws. The block moment calculation, bounded binary outcomes, append-block graph embeddings, explicit Gram diag(4K,12K), and empty recruitment check every standing, OLS and validity condition of the nonnecessity witness. Its maxima dominate the feasible empty-graph objective, whose scaled limit 15/64 exceeds 27/128.
